description: This file defines the CborFactory interface, which abstracts serialization/deserialization operations using CBOR within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for reading from and writing to CBOR formats, and creating CBOR representations from JSON data structures.

classes.name: CborFactory
classes.description: An interface providing methods for CBOR serialization and deserialization of JsonValue objects, including checks for CBOR library availability and methods to convert JsonValue structures to CBOR byte representations.

methods.name: isCborAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the CBOR serialization libraries are available (can be loaded).

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data from bytes or ByteBuffer using CBOR, returning a JsonValue.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Serializes a JsonValue into CBOR bytes.

methods.name: toByteBuffer
methods.description: Serializes a JsonValue into a CBOR ByteBuffer.

methods.name: writeToByteBuffer
methods.description: Serializes a JsonValue directly into a provided ByteBuffer.

methods.name: createCborRepresentation
methods.description: Creates a CBOR byte array representation from a JSON field map or a list of JsonValues, with an estimated size.

calls: readFrom(byte[] bytes, int offset, int length)
